notes: Mappings are one-to-one whenever possible so reverse translation is deterministic.
volume uses MSE X x Z x Y ordering.
Minecraft Y is an absolute MSE rendering coordinate in World Sync; the default Mindustry surface is Y=2.
Floor and wall semantics may share a Minecraft material because World State layer/kind disambiguates them.

render.note: Semantic footprint is 2x2; current fallback renderer fills the footprint until a sparse End Rod template is implemented.
